title.narrative: Value Chain Analysis

description.narrative: Value chain analysis will contribute to the achievement of the specific objective, to develop inclusive, sustainable and climate smart agriculture-based value chains. The studies will undertake a systematic and comprehensive analysis of a given value chain, taking into account economic, social and environmental factors by operationalising and applying the tool kit.
